info.title: Your test results - information about collection
info.warning: You do not need an ID document or an insurance card. All test results are only communicated personally.
info.welcome: Welcome to the online portal for test results. Here you can view the current status of your examination.
info.more_tests_subtitle: Depending on relevant history and issues, further tests can be carried out
info.more_tests_body: All test results are strictly confidential and will not be displayed online.
info.call_for_results_body: As soon as your test results are available, you will see the note here: "Results are available." Please contact the health department by phone to find out your results or make an appointment for a personal meeting.
important_background_points: Test results are exclusively communicated in person or by telephone.
If your results are not yet available, try again later.
In the event of a positive test result, you will receive further information and advisory services.
info.available_for_questions: We will be happy to answer any questions or to help you make an appointment.

login_and_view_status_card.title: Would you like to check the status of your results?
login_and_view_status_card.body: Please login here to view the current status of your results.

status.not_yet_available_info: There are no results from your appointment yet. Please try again later.
status.available_info: There are results from your appointment. Please make an appointment in the Health Department to discuss the findings.

view.still_no_results_body: If there are no results yet, we ask for a little patience - the update will take place as soon as possible. If you still have urgent questions, you can reach us by phone.
view.get_results_title: Would you like to make an appointment? Please call us.
view.get_results_body: Appointments for sharing and discussing the results can be arranged by phone.

go_to_card.title: Would you like to see your results status?
go_to_card.body: After your visit to the office, the tests are processed. You can check the status of your test results online at any time.
